title: SPARCL: Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning in Chest X-ray Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.17808v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pixel-level annotation for chest X-ray (CXR) lesion segmentation is expensive, making active learning (AL) essential. However, existing AL strategies fail to account for the spatial distribution of selected samples, resulting in inconsistent performance across focal (e.g., aortic calcification) and diffuse (e.g., nodules) pathologies. In this paper, we propose SPARCL (Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning) to dynamically balance predictive uncertainty with cumulative spatial coverage. By employing a concave coverage function, SPARCL imposes diminishing returns on previously annotated regions, naturally directing the annotation budget toward under-labeled areas. Furthermore, an entropy gate reverts the algorithm to standard uncertainty sampling when spatial variation is absent. translated_title: SPARCL：用于胸部X光分析中主动学习的空间自适应区域覆盖方法
translated_abstract: 胸部X光（CXR）病灶分割的像素级标注成本高昂，因此主动学习（AL）至关重要。然而，现有的主动学习策略未能考虑所选样本的空间分布，导致在局灶性病变（如主动脉钙化）和弥漫性病变（如结节）上的表现不一致。本文提出了SPARCL（空间自适应区域覆盖主动学习）方法，以动态平衡预测不确定性与累积空间覆盖率。通过采用凹覆盖函数，SPARCL对先前已标注的区域施加收益递减效应，从而自然地将标注预算引导至标注不足的区域。此外，当空间变化缺失时，熵门控机制会将算法恢复为标准的不确定性采样。该覆盖目标是单调次模的，从而保证了贪心批量选择具有近最优性。为了解决诸如聚合指标如何……
tldr: 提出SPARCL方法，利用凹覆盖函数动态平衡预测不确定性与空间覆盖率，解决胸部X光病灶分割主动学习中样本空间分布不均导致性能不一致的问题，并凭借单调次模性保证近最优的批量选择。
